title: Bounded admission diagnostics for queued VIXEN configure/build jobs
body: The live queue left w9-textures1:baseline-configure at the admission line for 625s with no CMake process or cache, then required cancellation and a second queued configure; queue history exposed a long-held blocker but the waiting command had no bounded diagnostic or recovery signal. Add a supported status/timeout path that reports the blocker and lets a lane recover without manual PID handling.
